$comment: kdreams observation watchlist. Observe-only: nothing in this repo places orders. pairs[] maps the same real-world event across venues; polymarketId is the Gamma conditionId, kalshiTicker is the Kalshi market ticker; a pair's polymarketTakerRate overrides fees.polymarketTakerRate because Polymarket sets taker rates per market. scan finds candidate pairs once a day (see scripts/kdreams-collect.mjs) and pins the pinTop closest to net positive; a scanned pair is a candidate, not a confirmed pair. Fee rates are published venue schedules as of 2026-10 and must be re-verified before any edge claim. backtest.horizonMinutes bounds the maker proxy in wall-clock time (snapshots are irregular); retestMinTicks is how many post-freeze ticks a frozen hypothesis needs before it is graded; retestMinN is the smallest sample a spec metric may be graded on.

pairs.name: house-2026-republican
pairs.note: Same outcome (Republican House control after the 2026 midterms). Resolution timing differs: Polymarket endDate 2026-11-04, Kalshi close 2027-02-01. Check both rule texts before any edge claim.

pairs.name: fed-2026-12-hike25
pairs.note: Same outcome: both resolve on the FOMC statement for the 2026-12-08/09 meeting. Edge cases differ: a canceled meeting resolves Kalshi to 'maintains' at once but Polymarket only after the next meeting's end date; Polymarket rounds an off-grid change up to the next 25 bps. Polymarket taker rate 0.05 is this market's feeSchedule.rate from Gamma (gamma-api.polymarket.com/markets?condition_ids=...), checked 2026-11-04.

pairs.name: fed-2026-12-hold
pairs.note: Sibling bracket of fed-2026-12-hike25: Polymarket 'no change' and Kalshi 'Fed maintains rate' are the same outcome; same rules and fee notes.

pairs.name: fed-2026-12-cut25
pairs.note: Sibling bracket of fed-2026-12-hike25 (Polymarket 'decrease by 25 bps', Kalshi 'Cut 25bps'): same rules and edge cases. Found by the 2026-11-10 scan. Polymarket taker rate 0.05 is this market's feeSchedule.rate from Gamma, checked 2026-11-10.

pairs.name: hormuz-2026-11-normal
pairs.note: Near-same outcome: both read the IMF PortWatch 7-day moving average of Strait of Hormuz transit calls for dates through 2026-11-30. Threshold wording differs: Polymarket resolves YES at 'equal to or above 60', Kalshi at 'above 60', so a maximum of exactly 60.0 resolves Polymarket YES and Kalshi NO, which loses both legs of 'ks YES + pm NO' (the direction that was positive on 2026-11-10). Polymarket also spells out revisions and a 14-day late-data window; Kalshi's market rules do not. Polymarket fees are off for this market (Gamma feesEnabled false, checked 2026-11-10). Found by the 2026-11-10 scan.
